description: This file contains customizations and extensions for invoice and invoice line models in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for handling tax-included/excluded pricing, refunds, and tax computations.

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extension of the invoice model with a 'price_type' field and refund method.

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Extension of invoice line with methods for calculating subtotals considering tax inclusion, default price unit, and change handlers.

classes.name: account_invoice_tax
classes.description: Extension of invoice tax computation to handle grouped tax amounts based on invoice data.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Creates a refund invoice and preserves the original 'price_type'.

methods.name: _amount_line2
methods.description: Calculates subtotal amounts for invoice lines, considering tax inclusion/exclusion.

methods.name: _price_unit_default
methods.description: Provides default unit price, adjusting for total check context.

methods.name: _get_invoice
methods.description: Retrieves invoice line IDs for a given invoice.

methods.name: move_line_get_item
methods.description: Prepares data for accounting move lines from invoice lines.

methods.name: product_id_change_unit_price_inv
methods.description: Adjusts unit price based on whether tax is included.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Overrides product change to pass 'price_type' in context.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Computes grouped tax amounts for an invoice, considering tax signs and currency conversions.
